newsitem.title: USA: Smithfield Foods gets option to buy firm.
newsitem.headline: Smithfield Foods gets option to buy firm.

text.p: Smithfield Foods Inc said on Tuesday it had obtained an option from Lykes Bros Inc, of Tampa, Fla., to acquire the assets and business of the Lykes Meat Group.
The transaction is subject to receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals. The sale is anticipated to be completed by mid-November, Smithfield said.
Lykes Meat Group makes and markets lunch meats, sausages, bacon, hams and other products in the southern United States. Lykes plans to focus on its beverage and citrus businesses.
